question: How has CI/validate runtime grown over the last ~10 days as the compat envelope went 1->6 backends? Daily median/p90 per lane, self-hosted + GitHub-hosted.
source: GitHub Actions API per-workflow queries (with-proxy gh api .../actions/workflows/<id>/runs), rrnewton/hermit + rrnewton/reverie
duration_metric: updated_at - run_started_at (seconds), completed runs only (conclusion != null)

hermit-portable-hosted.role: GitHub-hosted; carries the compat-envelope expansion matrix

hermit-privileged-selfhosted.role: self-hosted; near-instant, most runs SKIP (no /dev/kvm) -> not a duration signal

hermit-validation-levels.role: self-hosted validate.sh levels; went quiet after 07-26 in this window

interpretation: End-to-end CI wall-time scales ~linearly with backend columns; 1->6 backends over the window ~= 3x on the dominant (portable-hosted) lane, whose p90 is now at the GitHub-hosted job ceiling. Quantitative basis for the timeout-headroom work and for pruning/parallelizing the envelope DAG.
